--Opposite party ---
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK ROSHAN ---
For the Petitioner : Mr. Abhay Kr. Chaturvedy, Advocate For the State : Ms. Amrita Kumar, A.P.P --
03/03.06.2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P.
2.

The petitioner has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Latehar P.S.
Case No. 72 of 2024, registered for the offence under Sections 498A,304-B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the petitioner is the mother-in-law of the deceased and has been falsely implicated in this case.

Learned counsel further submits that during investigation, statement of the witnesses has been recorded, wherein they have stated that on the alleged day of occurrence the Petitioner had gone Nawada, Bihar and the co-accused, Doman Saw,
who happens to be the father-in-law of the deceased, has been granted bail by a coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 09.12.2024 in B.A. No. 8298 of 2024 and the petitioner is in custody since 12.03.2025.
4.
Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

sentences.text: Having regard to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that co- accused, Doman Saw, who happens to be the father-in-law of the deceased, has been granted bail by a coordinate Bench of this Court, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner 2025:JHHC:14470 on bail.

Accordingly, the above-named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar, in connection with Latehar P.S. Case No. 72 of 2024.

It is made clear that the petitioner shall appear on each and every date before the learned trial court and she shall not threaten any witness and shall co-operate in trial and if any adverse report will come against this petitioner, learned trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of this petitioner.
(Deepak Roshan, J.) jk Sarita Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand --Opposite Party on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155930592/
